modules.title: Introduction to Christian Ethics and Social Issues
modules.html:
Christian teaching on love, forgiveness, stewardship, honesty, marriage, leadership and social responsibility. This section covers introduction to christian ethics and social issues.

Key points

  • The first Christian martyr was _____. — Stephen.
  • The Christian virtue of 'Agape' means _____. — unconditional/divine love.
  • In Christian teaching, 'Civic Responsibility' involves _____. — all of the above.
  • The prophet who was a shepherd from Tekoa and preached against social injustice was _____. — Amos.
  • According to Christian teaching, the 'wages of sin is death', but the 'free gift of God is _____' in Christ Jesus. — eternal life.

Worked examples

Q: The first Christian martyr was _____.
A: Stephen — Stephen was stoned to death for his witness to Christ, as recorded in Acts 7.

Q: The Christian virtue of 'Agape' means _____.
A: unconditional/divine love — Agape is the highest form of love, representing God's selfless love for humanity.

quiz.q: The first Christian martyr was _____.
quiz.solution: Stephen was stoned to death for his witness to Christ, as recorded in Acts 7.

quiz.q: The Christian virtue of 'Agape' means _____.
quiz.solution: Agape is the highest form of love, representing God's selfless love for humanity.

quiz.q: In Christian teaching, 'Civic Responsibility' involves _____.
quiz.solution: Romans 13 and 1 Peter 2 emphasize that Christians should be good citizens and respect governing authorities.

quiz.q: The prophet who was a shepherd from Tekoa and preached against social injustice was _____.
quiz.solution: Amos was a simple shepherd and dresser of sycamore trees who fearlessly condemned the wealthy for oppressing the poor.

quiz.q: According to Christian teaching, the 'wages of sin is death', but the 'free gift of God is _____' in Christ Jesus.
quiz.solution: Romans 6:23 contrasts the consequence of sin with the gracious gift of eternal life through Christ.

quiz.q: The prophet known for his emphasis on social justice was...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Amos.

quiz.q: Who was the first Christian martyr?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Stephen.

quiz.q: The first Christian Martyr:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Stephen.

quiz.q: The prophet of Social Justice was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Amos.

quiz.q: Who said "Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian"?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: King Agrippa.

quiz.q: The first murder in the Bible was committed by _____.
quiz.solution: Cain killed his brother Abel out of jealousy because God accepted Abel's offering and not his.

quiz.q: The 'Valley of dry bones' vision was seen by Prophet _____.
quiz.solution: Ezekiel saw the vision of dry bones coming to life, symbolizing the restoration of Israel.

quiz.q: The golden calf made by the Israelites in the wilderness was facilitated by _____.
quiz.solution: While Moses was on Mount Sinai, the people pressured Aaron, who took their gold and fashioned it into a molten calf.

quiz.q: Jesus was baptized by John in the River Jordan to _____.
options: show He was a disciple of John
quiz.solution: In Matthew 3:15, Jesus told John to permit the baptism to 'fulfill all righteousness', identifying with humanity.

quiz.q: Jesus' triumphal entry into Jerusalem on a donkey was a fulfillment of the prophecy of _____.
quiz.solution: Zechariah 9:9 prophesied the King coming to Zion 'humble and riding on a donkey'.

quiz.q: The replacement for Judas Iscariot among the twelve apostles was _____.
quiz.solution: In Acts 1, the disciples cast lots and the lot fell on Matthias to join the eleven apostles.

quiz.q: The city of Jericho was captured by the Israelites under the leadership of _____.
quiz.solution: Joshua led the miraculous fall of Jericho's walls after circling the city for seven days.
